title: The Very Simple Case for Debate
author: Stefan Bauschard
summary: Bauschard argues for rebalancing education toward orality and debate practice, noting students spend years on writing assignments despite post-graduate communication relying on speaking. With AI reshaping socioeconomic and political order, robust debate and discussion become essential. He makes the case that debate leadership requires no prior experience, making it accessible to teachers across disciplines.
points: Students invest thousands of hours in writing assignments while post-graduate communication centers on speaking and debate.
AI will fundamentally alter socioeconomic and political structures, requiring citizens to understand and debate these changes.
Debate leadership and facilitation can be taught to any teacher willing to learn, removing the expertise barrier.
Orality deserves equal curricular status as literacy in preparing students for civic and professional life.
quotes: Post-graduate communication outside academia will generally involve speaking and debating. We need a rebalance toward orality.
AI will literally usher in new socioeconomic and political orders. We need to talk and debate about that.
Everyone can lead it, including those without previous experience.” Archived from Stefan Bauschard's Substack on May 2, 2026 by Tim.
